messages:
incident_bot: Pager ALERT: high rate of external tool invocations detected on prod-proxy (tool-proxy-pool). 5xx spike and queue growth. incident_id=INC-2026-0457; severity=sev2. Check runbook: /runbooks/tool-invoke-excess.
marta_oncall: I'm on it — joining bridge now. @sam_platform can you see if there's a recent deploy or config push to proxy? :eyes:
sam_platform: no deploys in last 30m. metrics show sudden spike in user traffic from a handful of tenants (t-142, t-87). Tool invocation qps up 6x. Rolling window latency > 2s for kv-cache hits.
kevin_eng: repeating errors: downstream 502 from external tool-adapter. Stack traces show repeated retries from action-executor. Might be amplification loop.
louise_support: I'm triaging customer impact. So far 8 active incidents reported, mostly timeouts when using third-party tools in flows. Prioritizing high-value tenants.
marta_oncall: mitigation options: 1) global soft-rate-limit on tool invocations 2) tenant-scoped invoke quarantine for noisy tenants 3) disable structured/tool-calls entirely for free tier 4) fall back to text-only generation for all streaming chats.
kevin_eng: recommend tenant-scoped first to reduce blast radius. We can flip invoke-quarantine for t-142 and t-87 via runtime flag. Command: ```./ctl runtime set-flag --name invoke_quarantine --tenants t-142,t-87 --reason "spike" --ttl 30m``` 
sam_platform: I'll apply tenant quarantine now.
sre_bot: action: set-flag requested by sam_platform. performing check: flags service healthy.
sam_platform: applied. confirm: invoke qps for t-142 dropped ~92% within 20s. backlog draining. :white_check_mark:
kevin_eng: good. still seeing high global tail latency from other tenants due to KV cache contention. Next step: enable text-only fallback for free-tier and burst-tier users to remove structured output pressure. Feature flag: ```/flags set text_only_fallback --plans free,burst --ttl 60m``` 
marta_oncall: agree. Louise can we prepare a short customer note for affected customers (free+burst) explaining degraded tool support and temporary fallback? Kept brief.
louise_support: drafting: "We are currently limiting external tool integrations and structured outputs to reduce errors. If your workflow requires tool calls, contact support for temporary whitelist. Expect degraded functionality for 60 minutes." Will post after ops confirms.
kevin_eng: also enabling runtime guard that drops function-call payloads > 2KB to avoid amplification: ```iptables-like-rule: drop-payload-size > 2048 bind tool-proxy``` this is applied at proxy edge.
sam_platform: guard deployed to edge cluster us-east-1. observing reduced downstream retries. overall 5xx rate falling from 3.2% -> 0.6%.
marta_oncall: nice work. next: update internal status and post to #incidents with short summary and ETA 60m. Louise, post customer note once I say go.
louise_support: ready. awaiting go.
marta_oncall: go ahead and post customer note now. I'll keep monitoring and will extend TTLs if needed.
louise_support: posted to status page and sent DM to impacted tenants. :email:
sre_bot: monitoring: error-rate trending down. alert thresholds returning to baseline.
kevin_eng: leave the tenant quarantine in place for another 30m then auto-lift. We'll follow up with post-incident analysis to add circuit-breakers per model-family.
marta_oncall: closing on-call actions. create incident ticket INC-2026-0457 with mitigation notes and owners: kevin (eng), sam (platform), louise (support). tagging for postmortem.
incident_bot: Incident INC-2026-0457 updated: status=mitigated, mitigation=tenant_quarantine+text-only-fallback+edge-payload-drop. Duration ~38m. Postmortem owner assigned: kevin_eng.
